card.name: "Not" starting a table cell
card.fires_on: The word "Not" (or "not") that begins a new table cell or fragment, right after a dose, weight band or sentence break. It is followed by words like recommended, applicable, approved, for or tolerated.

modes.label: Dose table cell
modes.description: "Not" opens a cell such as "Not recommended" or "Not applicable" after a weight band or dose in a dosing table.
